semantics: All four gate inputs must qualify for delayed activation.
A committed cessation timer survives restoration of its gate inputs.
Reactivation has its own supplied delay.
Encounter end or reset does not reset executor-owned controller or activity state.
RNA presence and functional protein availability are independent supplied inputs; RNA loss alone does not trigger protein-dependent cessation.

scenario_limit: The one-second clock is an arbitrary physical-time instantiation for software checking. It is not a measured or predicted one-second biological response. Actual delays and independently authored source deadlines remain distinct authorities; public assay windows supply neither.

observation_contract.schedule: One executor-owned readout evidence sample per integer tick from zero through the horizon, with explicit status and observed tick.
observation_contract.freshness: The scenario freshness applies to all six input channels and the activity readout; valid, missing and stale evidence retain RC5 semantics.
observation_contract.status_limit: Valid means supplied software observation evidence in this scenario, not a laboratory measurement.
observation_contract.missingness: Unknown required evidence does not rewrite physical inputs, cancel transitions or establish absence.
observation_contract.scope: Complete declared finite domain only; no numerical biological simulation.

assumptions: Both designer-supplied RNA members reach the same declared human CD8 T-cell executor in the intended in-vivo deployment; delivery is not demonstrated.
Each supplied protein-availability input represents sufficient correctly localized functional product at the cell surface; it is independent of the corresponding cytoplasmic RNA-presence input.
Effective AP21967 exposure is supplied categorically; concentration thresholds, pharmacokinetics, dosing and administration are outside this model.
The two products follow the supplied reversible delayed-AND abstraction; applying that abstraction to this RNA adaptation is unassessed.
Background and active are uncalibrated model bands and are not measured target-cell killing, cytokine release or clinical benefit; background does not mean zero cytotoxicity.
Actual delays of one tick and requested deadlines of two ticks are independently supplied modeling choices, not values extracted from public experiments.
The one-second-per-tick clock, ten-tick horizon, six-tick intervention cutoff and one-tick freshness bound are uncalibrated software-scenario assumptions and make no biological timing prediction.
Cessation of modeled receptor activity neither reverses earlier target-cell injury nor guarantees cessation of downstream cellular effects.
Categorical availability does not quantify protein concentration, expression, member ratio or molecular stoichiometry and cannot discharge requirements for those quantities.
The patent-pair identity is retained without asserting sequence identity with Wu I.b plus II.d; no Wu kinetic or assay evidence is transferred to this adaptation.

Decode canonical parent RNA bases with the standard genetic code and one terminal stop; declared N1-methylpseudouridine at canonical U positions is projected to U for nominal sequence correspondence only. Physical translation of modified nucleotides, processing and biological expression remain unmeasured assumptions.
